# Velair 1.9.0-beta.1

Velair 1.9.0-beta.1 adds Planned Return, reusable climate presets and complete template links, with faster panel and dashboard loading. This beta also fixes scheduling transitions missed during preconditioning or slow climate delivery.

## ✨ Added

- Added optional **Planned Return**: combine household occupancy signals, select Away and destination Modes, and prepare eligible climates for weekly arrivals. Heating, cooling and ranges are supported; Boost, manual control and pauses retain priority.
- Added **One-off return** for future dates, including without occupancy sources or an enabled weekly routine. With sources, departure requires confirmed absence; without them, planning a return activates Away immediately. Arrival edits and active returns survive restarts. Cancelling before departure leaves the active setup unchanged; after departure, it restores the saved Mode/Profile selection when still available and compatible. Panel and dashboard views show arrival, occupancy and preparation estimates. The climate card can expose the same controls; `velair.start_planned_return` and `velair.cancel_planned_return` support automations.
- Added a shared **Climate presets** library for Default schedules, Profiles and templates. Editing a preset updates its uses; compatibility checks and usage lists help identify affected schedules. `velair.update_block_preset` lets automations persistently update shared settings.
- Added complete per-day template links following both times and climate settings. Hours-only links retain independent settings. Unlinking preserves effective settings and preset references; incompatible shared edits are rejected before changing destinations.
- Added a **Seasonal climate selection** blueprint for winter, mild-weather and summer actions after a temperature reading remains stable. It supports Celsius/Fahrenheit, native Home Assistant action sequences and localized diagnostic notifications.
- Added all 24 registered documentation sources in nine non-English languages. Panel help opens the available guide in the Home Assistant language, with English fallback.

## 🔄 Changed

- Portable exports now use model version **16**, including template, preset and Planned Return dependencies. Existing backups remain importable. Planned Return imports disabled and excludes temporary episodes; older Velair versions cannot import version 16 exports. Keep a backup before testing a downgrade.

## 🚀 Improved

- Sidebar tabs and dashboard cards share data and live updates, reducing loading screens while keeping unsaved drafts independent. Direct links, refresh and browser Back/Forward preserve panel navigation.
- Shared-resource editors provide clearer effective settings, compatibility feedback, dependency protection and grouped usage lists. Schedule timelines identify linked resources and show their effective temperatures, ranges or actions.
- Day cloning preserves template link types, assignments and preset references across compatible climates. Default clones validate all destinations before saving them together; Profile clones validate before updating the draft. Independent template copies preserve preset references, while incompatible or outdated edits keep the previous schedules and drafts intact.
- Planned Return adds household and per-climate context to Diagnostics, with a filterable history of accepted transitions. Overview highlights active returns and relevant issues and links to their controls.
- Expanded contextual explanations throughout the panel, with direct **Open guide** links for schedules, Profiles, templates, presets, preconditioning, Planned Return, sensors, manual control and diagnostics. Schedule source help explains independent schedules, hours-only links and complete template links; read-only settings explain which linked resource controls them. This builds on the documentation access requested in [issue #34](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/34). Thanks to **@jimbexleyspeed** for the suggestion.
- Expanded user guides with practical household examples for shared presets, Winter/Summer Profiles, independent copies, link conversions, active overrides and device capabilities. Scheduling, sensors, automations, Planned Return and backup guidance explain how the features work together, using terminology aligned with the panel.
- Improved information buttons: a short hover delay avoids opening help when the pointer simply passes over a button, while keyboard focus and tap open it immediately. Compact, readable explanations stay within the viewport, longer help can scroll on mobile, and moving between the button and its message keeps the explanation open.

## 🛠️ Fixed

- Fixed scheduled blocks and early starts being skipped in other zones while one climate was preconditioning. Weekly early starts now respect the preceding block, including Off, and manual adjustments until the next block end at its scheduled time. Thanks to **@madnazz** for reporting [issue #39](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/39).
- When a slow climate action crosses another transition, Velair applies the currently authorized target without replaying obsolete or duplicate orders, while respecting overrides and delivery recovery.

## 🧭 Notes

- This is a beta for real-world testing. Automated and isolated browser checks passed; physical-device, live Home Assistant layout and Companion app lifecycle validation remains limited.
- Weekly Planned Return arrivals are same-day routines; one-off arrivals may use future dates. Preparation times are estimates. Avoid competing Home/Away Mode actions for the same household.
- Seasonal blueprint waits do not survive Home Assistant restarts or automation reloads. Import the blueprint separately from HACS integration updates; empty action sequences do not turn climates off.
- Translations are AI-assisted. Please report wording or terminology issues so we can improve them.
- After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser or companion app. If the previous interface remains visible, perform a hard refresh or clear the site cache.
